# ─── AI / Gemini ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Google AI Studio'dan ücretsiz anahtar alın: https://aistudio.google.com/apikey
# Sunucu taraflı kullanılır — frontend'e NEVER expose etmeyin (NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix'i yok).
GEMINI_API_KEY="your-gemini-api-key-here"
# Opsiyonel: varsayılan model gemini-2.0-flash, değiştirmek isterseniz:
# GEMINI_MODEL="gemini-2.0-flash"

# ─── Database Connection (Supabase PostgreSQL) ─────────────────────────────────
# Get this from your Supabase dashboard: Project Settings > Database > Connection string
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://postgres.[project-ref]:[password]@aws-0-[region].pooler.supabase.com:6543/postgres?pgbouncer=true"
# Opsiyonel: pg havuzu bağlantı zaman aşımı (ms). Uzak DB veya uykudan uyanan Supabase icin ornegin 30000
# DATABASE_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT_MS=30000

# NextAuth Configuration
# Generate a secret: openssl rand -base64 32
AUTH_SECRET="your-auth-secret-here"

# NextAuth URL (for production, use your Vercel domain)
NEXTAUTH_URL="https://your-app.vercel.app"

# Optional: Proxy URL for external APIs
PROXY_URL=""

# Supabase Configuration (for file storage)
# Get these from your Supabase dashboard: Project Settings > API
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL="https://[project-ref].supabase.co"
# Anon key: Dashboard > Settings > API — mesajlar için Realtime (isteğe bağlı; yoksa yoklama kullanılır)
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="your-anon-key-here"
SUPABASE_URL="https://[project-ref].supabase.co"
# Service Role Key (keep this secret! Only use on server-side)
# Get from: Project Settings > API > service_role key (secret)
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY="your-service-role-key-here"
